Bassist and vocalist Kristen Korb is becoming a well known artist in the west coast jazz scene. She makes her home in San Diego and often performs with flutist Holly Hofmann. Her debut album featured the Ray Brown Trio.
Kristen was interviewed in Scottsdale, Arizona on April 16, 2000, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Scottsdale, Arizona filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m quite pleased to have a young, up-and-coming jazz star, Kristen Korb, bassist, and you made quite an impression here at the festival so far.
I’m kind of at a disadvantage because I don’t know a lot about you.
Well that’s why we’re here. Tell me where you were born and when.
